_note: 360-degree path analyzer. Limits and statuses are data; the prompt is path_analyzer.md.
_evidence_item_note: Vault item types the analyzer may cite as item:<id> (FOUR_FEATURES_SPEC 1.2). Any other type (myth, quota, a new one) stays out until listed here.
_min_fit_note: A suggested field is kept only with at least min_fit_evidence fit items in fit_evidence_statuses, each citing the student. Fewer or zero paths is the correct answer when the fit is weak; never pad to max_paths.
_education_note: How an education record reads as path evidence: catalog labels, never codes. Hidden fields are internal levels; status codes have no catalog list, so their words live here.
_vault_trigger_types_note: Catalog types a path reads. A write to one queues the Path engine (reason vault), and path research (explanations, program searches) is current while none of them changed: relevance_version in memory/completeness.py.
_recall_note: Semantic recall (FOUR_FEATURES_SPEC 3): the query is the candidate field titles plus the student's Vault entries of recall_query_types; recall_top_k hits. A hit on a citable Vault entry (a profile card) carries its id; other hits (session summaries, document passages) are shown with id null and cannot be cited. A path's why must cite at least one Vault entry id (evidence_item_ids).
_field_notes_note: Shared field notes (BETA_CONVERSATION_SPEC 3.1; paths/field_research.py). After a run the analyzer queues research for at most field_notes_per_run candidate fields with no fresh note (saved paths first; a field that found nothing is tried again the next ISO week); the prompt's <field_notes> block shows the trusted facts of at most field_notes_in_prompt fields. default_country is used when the student's Vault has no current country. field_research: queries ({field}, {country}), search_limit results per query, fetch_limit pages in all, page_chars per page, the sections the note has (the description goes to the model), max_facts_per_section. quote_rules: a fact is kept only when its quote is on the page (line breaks ignored), has min_chars characters and min_words words, states every number the fact states, and shares content words with the fact (Jaccard of words of 3+ letters outside stopwords, at least min_overlap). Institutions: a fact naming one is dropped. The blocked names are institution_words plus every name and domain label in the institution catalog (pai_institutions, pai_institution_domains); a name of up to acronym_max_letters letters is matched only in capitals (FAST, UCP), a longer one in any case; institution_patterns are regexes matched in any case ((?-i:...) keeps a part case-sensitive). trusted_domains (with paths/policy.json trusted_domains and the hosts of admission_rules.json rows with confidence official) mark a fact trusted; a fact from any other site is kept as uncertain, never shown to the analyzer and never counted in the note's confidence. confidence: thresholds on trusted facts and sources; none gives uncertain.

queries: {field} degree what you study and careers in {country}

sections.what_you_study: The subjects and skills the degree teaches.
sections.work_day: What a typical working day looks like after the degree.
sections.entry: How students in {country} usually get in: the school background and the kind of entry test, without naming any institution.
sections.jobs_and_demand: The kinds of jobs it leads to and how much demand there is in {country}.
sections.myths: Common beliefs about this field that the sources correct.

paths_found_message: Here are the paths I found from what you have shared.
_needs_education_note: When a chat-requested analysis cannot place the student, PAI posts one short message saying what it needs. needs_education_by_level picks the message from the level the education record names; a level not listed (or none) asks for the education itself. Only runs the student asked for in chat (needs_education_post_reasons) post it; the Paths page says it on its own.

needs_education_messages.group: Which group are you in, Pre-Engineering, Pre-Medical, ICS, I.Com or FA?
needs_education_messages.subjects: Which A-level subjects are you taking?
needs_education_messages.field: Which field are you studying, for example Computer Science or BBA?
